title: Gold nanoclusters Au(25)AcCys(18) normalize intracellular ROS without increasing cytoplasmic alarmin acHMGB1 abundance in human microglia and neurons.
authors: Zhang, Issan; Maysinger, Dusica; Beus, Maja; Mravak, Antonija; Yu, Ziqi; Peric Bakulic, Martina; Dion, Patrick A; Rouleau, Guy A; Bonacic-Koutecky, Vlasta; Antoine, Rodolphe; Sanader Marsic, Zeljka
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金纳米簇调控人神经细胞ROS及acHMGB1丰度，涉及TFEB-DNA互作和AlphaFold建模，但核心非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: This study focuses on the modulatory effects of gold nanoclusters with 25 gold atoms and 18 acetyl cysteines (Au(25)AcCys(18)) in human microglia, human iPSC-derived neurons and SH-SY5Y differentiated human neuronal cells. The combination of chemical, biological, and computational methods shows the well-retained viability of these human cells treated with Au(25)AcCys(18), interactions between Au(25)AcCys(18) and transcription factor TFEB (computational approach), interactions between TFEB and HMGB1 (proximity ligation assay and molecular modeling using AlphaFold), modulation of the abundance and location of acHMGB1 by Au(25)AcCys(18) (immunocytochemistry), and the reduction of ROS in cells treated with Au(25)AcCys(18) (CellROX live imaging). These novel findings in human neural cells, particularly neurons, encourage further studies in experimental animal models of neurological disorders and/or human organoids to exploit the unique structural and photophysical properties of gold nanoclusters and to better understand their ability to modulate molecular mechanisms in human cells.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于含有25个金原子和18个乙酰半胱氨酸的金纳米簇（Au(25)AcCys(18)）在人小胶质细胞、人iPSC来源神经元及SH-SY5Y分化人神经元细胞中的调节作用。化学、生物学和计算方法的结合显示，经Au(25)AcCys(18)处理的人细胞活力保持良好，Au(25)AcCys(18)与转录因子TFEB之间的相互作用（计算方法），TFEB与HMGB1之间的相互作用（邻近连接法和使用AlphaFold的分子建模），Au(25)AcCys(18)对acHMGB1丰度和定位的调节（免疫细胞化学），以及经Au(25)AcCys(18)处理的细胞中ROS的减少（CellROX活细胞成像）。这些在人神经细胞，特别是神经元中的新发现，鼓励在神经系统疾病的实验动物模型和/或人器官样体中进行进一步研究，以利用金纳米簇独特的结构和光物理特性，并更好地理解其调节人细胞分子机制的能力。
